justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Strongest dyspnea reduction of any intervention in COPD; sustained 5-year gains in 6MWD and HRQL across multiple Cochrane reviews.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: AACVPR certification requires significant clinical experience documentation plus exam; moderate cost.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable only in dedicated pulmonary rehab programs; very limited in general outpatient or acute care settings.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: CMS requires AACVPR-aligned program standards for pulmonary rehab Medicare billing (CPT 94625/94626); direct reimbursement gating.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: High demand within pulmonary rehab programs; narrow employer base limits overall demand score.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: High adherence when transportation addressed; group format improves social engagement and self-efficacy.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: COPD/pulmonary patients are overwhelmingly Medicare and insurance-driven; almost no cash-pay market for pulmonary rehab.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Hospital-based reimbursement model with capped rates; no premium pricing pathway.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Uncommon in private practice but rarely a differentiator that draws consumers in the door.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Could theoretically train staff but the patient pipeline depends on physician referral, not branding.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Patients seek pulmonologists, not pulm rehab brands; low DTC recognition.
justifications.business.efficiency: Program training is moderate cost/time but ROI in cash-pay context is poor.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Recognized as legitimate specialty content area, especially for cardiopulm faculty lines.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Strong literature base, active research community, AACVPR-affiliated publications.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Directly maps to cardiopulm curricular threads in DPT programs.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Robust RCT and systematic review evidence base for exercise in COPD.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Helpful for cardiopulm faculty posts but most programs hire CCS-credentialed faculty preferentially.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Reasonable time investment relative to CCS board specialty.
